# railway_access_group_project (Resource)

Railway workspace access group project attachment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "railway_access_group_project" "example" {
  workspace_id    = railway_access_group.example.workspace_id
  access_group_id = railway_access_group.example.id
  project_id      = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_group_id` (String) Identifier of the access group.
- `project_id` (String) Identifier of the project to attach to the access group.
- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the workspace the access group belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the access group project attachment.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env sh

# Access group projects can be imported using `workspace_id:access_group_id:project_id`.
terraform import railway_access_group_project.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003
```
